no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: QT Imaging is a medical imaging device company. Its commercial QT Breast Scanner is FDA 510(k)-cleared (K162372 in 2017; expanded as K220933 in 2022). Pipeline products (QT Infant Scanner, QT Orthopedic Scanner) are also expected to use the 510(k) pathway, which does not require Phase 1/2/3 interventional clinical trials. Existing clinical studies (NCT06175078, NCT07216274) are investigator-initiated observational diagnostic-accuracy / pilot studies sponsored by academic centers, not company-sponsored pivotal IDE trials. No active P1/P2/P3 drug or pivotal IDE pipeline. Note: QTIWW is the warrant ticker; QTI/QTIH is the common-stock ticker for the same issuer.
